cds.title: Austin Peay State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-year class (CDS C1: 9,093 applied, 8,812 admitted, 1,847 enrolled). The CDS residency breakdown (in-state, out-of-state, international) is left at zero, so international applicant and admit counts are not published; B2 shows 21 nonresident first-time first-year students and 210 nonresident undergraduates. Undergrad enrollment 9,593 is the B1/B2 total undergraduate figure. C11 also reports 2.44% of students with a GPA below 1.0, which is not in the distribution above. SAT figures rest on only 21 students (1%); ACT was submitted by 975 (53%).

cost.notes: CDS G1 and G5 (first-year, 2026-27): the CDS lists one non-resident tuition figure ($13,788) equal to out-of-state tuition, used here as the rate for international students. CDS H6 marks institutional scholarship and grant aid as not available to degree-seeking nonresidents; the nonresident award count and average are blank.
